voice: A fast-talking, impatient New York street vendor whose comic sales obsession does not depend on mock-Italian spelling.

entries.text: What do I look like, the Answer Man? I don't know anything except corned-beef sandwiches, and I have one right here!
Never met the fellow. I'm too busy meeting customers and selling sandwiches. Corned-beef sandwiches!
Sorry, lady, never been there. Do you want a sandwich or not? Hot corned beef!
It is a nice, fresh, hot corned-beef sandwich. You asked for it; you eat it!
I don't know anything about it, lady. What I know is that I have a fine hot corned-beef sandwich here. Do you want one or not?
Mamma mia, another coupon! I'm going to go broke. What a crummy idea, advertising in the newspaper.
Take your sandwich and get out of here before I change my mind.
You bought the corned-beef sandwich; you eat the corned-beef sandwich!
Hot corned beef! Get your hot corned-beef sandwich!
Lean corned beef? This is the leanest corned beef in the city--maybe in the country. So lean the cow kept tipping over. You want a sandwich, lady?
Hot corned beef! Get your hot corned-beef sandwich!
Of course it smells wonderful. It is a nice hot corned-beef sandwich. Do you want one?
All right! Hot corned beef here! Corned-beef sandwiches!
Hot corned beef! Get your hot corned-beef sandwich!
Lady, if you want to smell the corned beef, you have to buy a sandwich. Are you buying or not?
Then stand somewhere else. You're blocking the customers. Hot corned beef here!
